description.value: Resthaven Store is a convenience store located in Sidney, BC, on the southern Saanich Peninsula — a popular cycling destination connecting the BC Ferries terminal at Swartz Bay with the town of Sidney and the Lochside Regional Trail. As a neighbourhood convenience store, it may offer basic supplies useful to touring cyclists passing through the area.
